title: Create an Angular library
description: Create an Angular library under `libs/<domain>[/<subdomain>...]/[<group>/]<type>`, wrapping `@nx/angular:library` with the workspace naming, directory, and tag conventions (ADR 0009). Restricted to the Angular `type:` values (`core`, `data-access`, `feature`, `ui`) and the `platform:frontend` `testing` and `utils` libraries. A `types` library comes from the `ts-lib` generator.

examples.description: Generates `billing-feature` at `libs/billing/feature` with a `billing-feature.routes.ts` and no starter component.
Generates `billing-format-utils` at `libs/billing/format/utils` with `billing-format.ts` and its spec.

type.description: The project's `type:` tag and the final directory segment. `core`, `data-access`, `feature` and `ui` are the Angular library types; `testing` and `utils` are their `platform:frontend` forms (ADR 0009).

domain.description: The product domain (and optional `/`-separated subdomains, e.g. `billing/checkout`) this library belongs to.

group.description: An optional label distinguishing this library from siblings of the same type within its domain. Omittable for a domain-singleton type; expected from the first library for a type that's typically many-per-domain (`utils`, `testing`) to avoid a rename later (ADR 0009).

name.description: Literal project-name override passed straight through to `@nx/angular:library`. When given, it replaces the derived name; the directory is still derived from `domain`/`group`/`type`.

publishable.description: Generate a publishable library. Requires `--importPath`. Always `false` for a `testing` library. No `nx release` group includes libraries yet, so Nx logs that it could not find one for the new library.

buildable.description: Generate a buildable library. Always `false` for a `testing` library.

prefix.description: The prefix to apply to generated selectors. Defaults to `ct` (Cybertec), which keeps the selectors apart from Cypress's `cy`.

skipTsConfig.description: Do not update `tsconfig.json` for development experience.

routing.description: Add router configuration. Defaults to `true` for a `feature` library and `false` for every other type. A `ui`, `data-access`, `utils` or `testing` library is always generated without routing, and `ui`, `data-access` and `testing` log a warning when it is requested. See `lazy` for more information.

lazy.description: With `--parent`, register the library in the parent route configuration with `loadChildren` when set to true, and with `children` when set to false. Requires `--routing`. A library with a module also gets `RouterModule.forChild` when true, and a simple array of routes when false.

parent.description: Path to the parent route configuration that registers the library, using `loadChildren` or `children`, depending on what `lazy` is set to. A library without a module is registered by its routes export.

tags.description: Add tags to the library (used for linting).

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner to use for unit tests. Defaults to `vitest-analog`, which uses the AnalogJS-based setup with `@nx/vitest` and works for any library. `vitest-angular` uses the `@nx/angular:unit-test` executor and requires a buildable or publishable library, but `@nx/angular` rejects it while the workspace's Vitest is outside the range `@nx/angular` pins (`^4.0.8`). `none` skips the test setup.

importPath.description: The library name used to import it, like `@myorg/my-awesome-lib`. Must be a valid npm name.

strict.description: Create a library with stricter type checking and build optimization options.

linter.description: The tool to use for running lint checks.

compilationMode.description: Specifies the compilation mode to use. If not specified, it will default to `partial` for publishable libraries and to `full` for buildable libraries. The `full` value can not be used for publishable libraries.

enableTypedLinting.description: Whether to enable typed linting. For flat configs, this configures the recommended `parserOptions.projectService` and `tsconfigRootDir`. For legacy `.eslintrc` configs, this configures `parserOptions.project`. We do not enable this by default for lint performance reasons.

skipModule.description: Whether to skip the creation of a default module when generating the library. Defaults to `true`, and a `data-access`, `utils` or `testing` library always skips it. A module is generated only with `--standalone=false --skipModule=false`.

standalone.description: Generate a starter standalone component as the library's entry point. Defaults to `false`, so a library starts without a component. A `data-access`, `utils` or `testing` library never gets one, and `data-access` and `testing` warn when one is asked for.

displayBlock.description: Specifies if the component generated style will contain `:host { display: block; }`. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

inlineStyle.description: Include styles inline in the component.ts file. Only CSS styles can be included inline. By default, an external styles file is created and referenced in the component.ts file. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

inlineTemplate.description: Include template inline in the component.ts file. By default, an external template file is created and referenced in the component.ts file. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

viewEncapsulation.description: The view encapsulation strategy to use in the new component. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

changeDetection.description: The change detection strategy to use in the new component. It defaults to `OnPush` for Angular versions >= 22.0.0 and `Default` for lower versions. _Note: the `Eager` value is only supported in Angular versions >= 22.0.0_. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

style.description: The file extension or preprocessor to use for style files, or `none` to skip generating the style file. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

skipTests.description: Do not create `spec.ts` test files for the new component. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

selector.description: The HTML selector to use for this component. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

skipSelector.description: Specifies if the component should have a selector or not. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.

flat.description: Ensure the generated standalone component is not placed in a subdirectory. Disclaimer: This option is only valid when `--standalone` is set to `true`.
